title: Type Usage
slide_intent: Show where each type voice belongs in an interface or campaign. Readers need the control to be immediately intelligible while a headline can carry more personality.
strategic_value: Instacart can maintain a dependable Sans voice for product tasks and reserve Contrast for moments that deserve attention.
demonstration: The board pairs search, offer and deal controls with an order-complete card, a Giving Tuesday message and a large homemade headline on green.
practical_value: Use the control samples to choose a product face and the campaign or status samples to place a more expressive headline.
